array.string: /bin/launchctl setenv DISABLE_TELEMETRY 1 DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING 1 DISABLE_FEEDBACK_COMMAND 1 DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER 1 CLAUDE_CODE_TETHER_LIVE 1 # 关了遥测，Claude Code 就读不到账号的线程开关；CLAUDE_CODE_TETHER_LIVE 强制打开消息线程，后续轮次不再重传历史图片。 # magpie 也在登录时启动，先后不定：先起的拿不到这个变量。它刚起、还没有会话时重启一次，起了 3 分钟以上不碰。 p="" for i in $(seq 1 60); do p=$(/usr/bin/pgrep -P 1 -x magpie | head -1); [ -n "$p" ] && break; sleep 1; done [ -n "$p" ] || exit 0 /bin/ps eww -o command= -p "$p" | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -qx 'CLAUDE_CODE_TETHER_LIVE=1' && exit 0 etime=$(/bin/ps -o etime= -p "$p" | tr -d ' ') case "$etime" in *-*|*:*:*) exit 0 ;; esac [ "$((10#${etime%%:*}))" -lt 3 ] || exit 0 kill -TERM "$p" for i in $(seq 1 20); do kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 1; done /usr/bin/open -a magpie
